sections.label: MOE Kindergartens by 2025
sections.summary: By 2025, at least 60 MOE Kindergartens will be operated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: By 2025, we will operate at least 60 MOE Kindergartens.

sections.label: Blended learning and digital devices
sections.summary: MOE will make blended learning part of the curriculum from next year and accelerate giving personal digital learning devices to all secondary students by end-2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Building on our experience with home-based learning, MOE will make blended learning an integral feature of the curriculum from next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As part of our National Digital Literacy Programme, we will accelerate the roll out of personal digital learning devices to all secondary school students by end-2021.

sections.label: Phasing out secondary school streaming
sections.summary: By 2024, streaming will be phased out and Full Subject-Based Banding implemented across secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: By 2024, streaming will be phased out and Full Subject-Based Banding will be implemented across secondary schools.

sections.label: SFEd roadmap and education reshaping
sections.summary: SFEd gives teachers a roadmap in six areas, and MOE is reshaping education and working with partners to help Singaporeans learn for life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: SFEd provides a roadmap for all teachers to strengthen their practice in six areas: assessment literacy, differentiated instruction, inquiry-based learning, e-pedagogy, CCE, and support for students with special educational needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the midst of crisis, we are seizing opportunities to reshape our education system for the longer term, and to accelerate improvements in the way we teach and learn.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In partnership with parents, employers, and community, we will help Singaporeans to learn for life and learn from life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will continue to uplift our people and expand opportunities for progression, as part of our overall efforts to build a more fair and just society.
